name: mcp-health
description: A mod that shows `mcp: <server> ✗` under the prompt while an MCP server's latest tool call errored, hidden while all are fine, with an optional toast on each server's first error.

enabled.title: Enable the mod
enabled.description: Off removes the failing-server segment and its toast. Takes effect after a reload or in a new session. Only an exact false turns it off.

toast_on_first_error.title: Toast on first error
toast_on_first_error.description: Show a toast the first time each MCP server returns an error in a session.

ignore_servers.title: Ignored MCP servers
ignore_servers.description: MCP server names to leave out of the failing-server line and toast, separated by commas or spaces. Give only the <server> part of the tool name mcp__<server>__<tool>, for example github, not mcp__github.
